latest_release.name: Version 5.1.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* prettify: configurable indentation step, faster indentation (supersedes #2916) by @lemire in https://github.com/simdjson/simdjson/pull/2994
* README: add Apache Arrow to real-world usage by @lemire in https://github.com/simdjson/simdjson/pull/2993
* keep the parser's settings in threaded parse_many and iterate_many by @jmestwa-coder in https://github.com/simdjson/simdjson/pull/2996
* ondemand: user-provided value() constructor to avoid store-forwarding stalls with GCC 15/16 by @lemire in https://github.com/simdjson/simdjson/pull/2999
* Do not end fractured_json lines with alignment padding by @ybai08 in https://github.com/simdjson/simdjson/pull/2995
* Count fractured_json separators without padding when it is off by @ybai08 in https://github.com/simdjson/simdjson/pull/3000
* Write the containers in fractured_json table cells inline by @ybai08 in https://github.com/simdjson/simdjson/pull/3001
* dom: escape strings with the builder's SIMD escaper (supersedes #2997) by @lemire in https://github.com/simdjson/simdjson/pull/2998
* dom: do not stop at a null character in at_key_case_insensitive by @jmestwa-coder in https://github.com/simdjson/simdjson/pull/3003
* cmake: build the benchmarks that need counters only when it is available by @lemire in https://github.com/simdjson/simdjson/pull/3006
* cmake: offline developer builds work as packaged, and are tested in CI by @lemire in https://github.com/simdjson/simdjson/pull/3007
* CI: fix the offline workflow (duplicate env keys) by @lemire in https://github.com/simdjson/simdjson/pull/3008


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/simdjson/simdjson/compare/v5.1.0...v5.1.1
